title: Doha: Half-Day Desert Safari, Dune Bashing & Khor Al Adaid Inland Sea
titleAr: الدوحة: سفاري صحراوي نصف يوم، ركوب الكثبان وبحر خور العديد الداخلي
shortDescription: Discover Qatar's unique natural wonder where towering golden desert dunes meet the azure waters of the Arabian Gulf at Khor Al Adaid with sandboarding and camel ride.
shortDescriptionAr: اكتشف معجزة قطر الطبيعية الخلابة حيث تلتقي الكثبان الرملية الذهبية بمياه البحر الفيروزية في خور العديد مع التزلج على الرمال وركوب الجمال.
cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours in advance
cancellationPolicyAr: إلغاء مجاني حتى 24 ساعة قبل موعد الرحلة
highlights: Exciting roller-coaster dune bashing over colossal sea-facing dunes in 4x4 Land Cruisers
Visit UNESCO-recognized Khor Al Adaid (The Inland Sea)
Traditional Bedouin camel ride along the desert edge with panoramic gulf views
Sandboarding down giant steep sand slopes with expert instructors
Complimentary Arabic Karak tea, mineral water, and sunset photo opportunities

itinerary.title: Doha Hotel / Airport Pickup
itinerary.desc: Convenient pickup from any hotel, residence, or Hamad International Airport in Doha in a luxury 4x4.

itinerary.desc: Adrenaline-fueled 45-minute dune riding across the singing sand dunes of Qatar.

itinerary.desc: Gaze across the gulf waters towards Saudi Arabia while watching the golden sunset over the tide.

itinerary.title: Return Drop-Off in Doha
itinerary.desc: Comfortable drop-off back to your starting point.

exclusions: Personal quad bike rental (optional add-on at base camp)
